attempts.evidence: Pass 1 — full 2000x2294 raster. Legend top-left carries two rows: a red swatch "premature — mistake · failing (runoff)" and a green swatch "solved 34 km/h — ideal · good", which is exactly the manifest's two legend entries (J1 pass). Two hourglass turn-point glyphs sit on the bottom straight, the red one visibly LEFT of the green one — the premature turn-in, drawn where it happens (J2 pass). "premature turn point" leads to the red hourglass and "late apex — sight and exit" leads to a point on the green line inside the corner; both boxes are inside the frame and clear of other ink (J3 pass). The oncoming vehicle is drawn as a dark quad in the upper lane and the road beyond it is rendered in a distinctly darker grey than the road in front of it — the occlusion wash — with two dashed sight rays, one pale red and one pale green, running from each line's eye toward its own limit point (J4 pass). J5 is the judgment: the red line turns in first, crosses inside the green line through the middle of the corner, and then cannot hold the exit — it diverges outward and terminates on the OUTER edge, pointed up the road at the lane the vehicle occupies. That is the lesson (premature turn point → wide exit into what you could not see) read straight off the drawing (J5 pass). Nothing appears that the manifest does not declare (J7 pass); at 2x the red and green are unmistakable and every glyph of text is crisp (J8 pass). mode="true" so J6 is na; D45 fan promotion is absent from v0.1 so J9 is na.

Pass 2 — SVG draw list against the committed manifest. Two trajectory polylines only: data-line-id="bad" stroke #b32e2e marker-end url(#arrow-failing) at width 0.0653, and data-line-id="good" stroke #1f6f43 marker-end url(#arrow-good) at width 0.0891. The manifest declares bad/mistake/failing and good/ideal/good, and QUALITY_COLOUR maps failing→#b32e2e, good→#1f6f43 — both strokes match their declared class exactly, and the ideal carries the wider W_IDEAL stroke (J1 pass, and the role tier is honest). data-marker-class inventory: turn_point x1 on good, turn_point x1 on bad, and nothing else — which is precisely what `marks: turn_point` licenses, with no apex/exit/release glyph fabricated (J2 pass, J7 pass). Stages present: 1-background, 2-road-surface, 3-lane-markings, 5-occluders, 6-occlusion, 7-sight-rays, 8-lines, 9-markers, 10-labels, 11-chrome — the 6-occlusion stage and 2 data-ray-line entries exist only on this figure, the only one of the six whose scene declares an occluder (J4 pass). One data-terminal-reason="off_road" on bad and none on good; good's arrowhead is its own polyline marker-end, i.e. the road_end/plain-arrow case (J5 corroborated). One <text> callout beyond the legend rows (J3 corroborated).

Pass 3 — high-zoom crop of the failing terminal at (1600,1300)+400x300 in the 2x frame. The red arrowhead is planted with its tip ON the road/grass boundary: the grey surface ends and the pale-green ground begins at the arrow tip, and the short thick edge tick that render/ink.ts pairs with `arrow_tick` is visible running along the edge at the crossing. The endpoint neither wanders into the grass nor runs out of the frame uncropped — the standing sentence holds. Same crop confirms the green ideal line is still comfortably inside the corridor at that station, so the two lines are separated by a clear margin at the moment the mistake line leaves (J5 pass, J8 pass at this zoom).
